claims.claim: The commit changes only the seven permitted files and adds no roadmap, lifecycle, Reviewer, Publisher, Runtime, or H4E live-conformance behavior.
An available unique exact target uses the existing attachment and surface guards without launch, navigation, acquisition configuration, or duplicate page creation.

Origin-only acquisition uses one bounded attempt budget, launches only the explicitly configured local Chromium executable/profile, connects only to the bound endpoint, and reaches the exact bound chat URL.

Missing-target acquisition requires proved endpoint ownership and one default browser context, issues at most one page-creation request, and rejects duplicate targets, ambiguous contexts, redirects, and target drift.

Acquisition rejects invalid configuration, locked profiles, endpoint mismatch, and unproved ownership. It performs no browser/profile/account configuration discovery, browser termination, rebind, or routing fallback; inherited surface guards reject authentication uncertainty.

Acquisition requires canonical UNRESOLVED state and exact original affinity/Binding, then repeats freshness and binding barriers after acquisition and before insertion/click. Resolution or binding changes block submission.

Delivery retains the existing surface, draft, generation, dedupe, durable pre-click ambiguity, per-pass submission limit, and exact user-turn guards. Ambiguous reconciliation remains proof-only and cannot acquire or resend.

The workflow retains selector-only inputs and read-only permissions. Acquisition configuration is inherited locally without browser URLs, endpoints, paths, credentials, or account selectors in workflow inputs/outputs.

Added deterministic inert fixtures covering attachment, bounded launch, exact page acquisition, configuration/profile/context failures, canonical and binding races, Human guards, exact submission, and ambiguous no-resend without live ChatGPT access.

Documentation records the bounded acquisition, local availability/privacy boundary, and failure cases, and leaves H4D closure and H4E live conformance downstream of reviewed publication and separate Human/Brain live proof.
